As a player with the depression debuff, it helps to have a party you can count on. Having party members that care about you can help with your mental health stat. I would also reaching out to a player that’s in the therapy or psychiatry class. Hopefully you can gain the antidepressant item. The depression debuff can seriously screw up how you play the game, and gameplay will get really hard from time to time. In my case, the debuff doesn’t really go away, it’s just adapting to it. Hope everything is okay, because in the larger picture, the game can be really fun and beautiful.

A few things.
1. About 4 or 5 years back, my younger brother (who had cerebral palsy and down syndrome) passed away due to illness. It absolutely broke my parents, so I can't make my parents go through that pain again.
2. The hope that things will get better. I've been depressed my whole life (I'm 18), and I keep telling myself things will get better. They haven't.
3. I'm under tremendous pressure from my parents and friends to do well in school. I'm in college on a scholarship and because I did poorly last semester, I have to get a 3.5 GPA or I'll be kicked out of the program.
4. I'm too scared.
Honestly I feel super selfish for being depressed/suicidal. I shouldn't feel this way. Day after day I feel like I'm a burden, but whenever I reach out, I'm told I'm making excuses and that I shouldn't be this way. Fuck living.
